entities.name: Indatha
entities.description: Black-green-white triome region on Ikoria with bioluminescent wetlands and nightmare monsters.

entities.name: Indath
entities.description: Legendary enormous creature said to have made the marshes with its footprints.

entities.name: Rielle
entities.description: Sage who believes Indath once walked the path.

entities.name: Nethroi
entities.description: Indatha's apex predator, a cat-nightmare-beast hybrid able to raise the dead.

entities.name: The frondlands
entities.description: Swampy forest that is Nethroi's lair.

entities.name: Orn
entities.description: Ruins of a once-fortified settlement, ancestral home of Skysail's builders.

entities.name: Skysail
entities.description: Skybound community of tethered airships above Indatha.

entities.name: Nightmare clade
entities.description: Dominant monster clade of Indatha, associated with primal fears.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who encountered an eyeless nightmare.

events.summary: Vivien Reid encounters a nightmare with no eyes that hunts with disturbing accuracy.
events.quote: The planeswalker Vivien Reid once encountered a nightmare creature with no eyes whatsoever

relations.note: One of the triomes of Ikoria.
relations.quote: Indatha is one of the three-colored regions, or triomes , found on the plane of Ikoria .
serves as the lair of Nethroi , Indatha's apex predator
